How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
For the EOS Classic, set it on a firm, flat foundation (slats should be no more than 3 inches apart), and don’t place the mattress directly on the floor. The coil unit goes on the bottom, with the latex layer above it. Rotate and flip the top comfort layers every 3–4 months to help promote even wear.
